result.rationale: The diff shows next/previous actions set offset then call group.findMembers() (an async ajax with no request token/cancellation), and findMembers blindly applies whatever response arrives via setProperties. Rapid clicks can thus produce overlapping requests where a stale response overwrites newer state, making members list inconsistent with displayed currentPage/offset. The mechanism is fully visible in the diff and describes incorrect behavior introduced by this change.

adjudication.rationale: In admin-group.js.es6, actions next/previous update model.offset then immediately call group.findMembers() without any in-flight request guard/cancellation. In discourse/models/group.js, findMembers() issues an async Discourse.ajax and on completion unconditionally self.setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members }) based on that response’s meta. With rapid pagination clicks, multiple requests can overlap and resolve out of order; a slower earlier response can overwrite members/offset from a later click, making the rendered member list and computed currentPage/offset reflect the “wrong” page.
